mapper.select:
SELECT E.EVENT_ID, E.EVENT_TITLE, E.STARTED_AT, E.ENDED_AT, E.EVENT_STATUS, E.CREATED_AT, (SELECT I.IMAGE_URL FROM EVENT_IMAGE I WHERE I.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID AND I.IMAGE_TYPE = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER LIMIT 1) AS THUMBNAIL_URL FROM EVENT E
ORDER BY E.EVENT_ID DESC LIMIT #{startNum}, #{pageSize}

SELECT E.*, (SELECT I.IMAGE_URL FROM EVENT_IMAGE I WHERE I.EVENT_ID = E.EVENT_ID AND I.IMAGE_TYPE = 'THUMBNAIL' ORDER BY I.DISPLAY_ORDER LIMIT 1) AS THUMBNAIL_URL FROM EVENT E WHERE E.EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
AND E.EVENT_STATUS != 'HIDDEN'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO EVENT ( EVENT_TITLE, EVENT_CONTENT, STARTED_AT, ENDED_AT, EVENT_STATUS, CREATED_AT ) VALUES ( #{eventTitle}, #{eventContent}, #{startedAt}, #{endedAt}, #{eventStatus}, NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE EVENT SET EVENT_TITLE = #{eventTitle}, EVENT_CONTENT = #{eventContent}, STARTED_AT = #{startedAt}, ENDED_AT = #{endedAt}, EVENT_STATUS = #{eventStatus} WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId}
mapper.select: SELECT IMAGE_ID AS imageId, IMAGE_URL AS imageUrl, IMAGE_ORIGIN_NAME AS imageOriginName, IMAGE_NAME AS imageName, IMAGE_SIZE AS imageSize, IMAGE_TYPE AS imageType, DISPLAY_ORDER AS displayOrder FROM EVENT_IMAGE WHERE EVENT_ID = #{eventId} ORDER BY DISPLAY_ORDER
